name: Old Parliament House, Athens
scope: The Old Parliament House at 13 Stadiou Street in Athens as photographed in August 2014. Includes the connected historic building, recessed courtyards, porticos, stairs, parapets and roof silhouette. The National Historical Museum occupies the building. Detached monuments, neighboring buildings and interiors are outside this model.

originalReview.notes: Wider north courtyard view establishes the recessed portico, lower wings, stair width, tiered roof parapets and flag position.

references.filename: Old parliament of Greece in Stadiou street Athens.jpg

originalReview.notes: Close view shows four fluted Ionic columns, triangular pediment, oxblood portico backing, pale stairs, rustication and repeated cornice bands.

review.method: Exact published Qualla originals with native Commons SHA-1, pinned revisions and explicit CC0 dedications
review.notes: Two exact published Qualla originals were accepted. Both are the uploader’s own August 2014 exterior photographs with explicit CC0 dedications. They show the same courtyard portico. Other Qualla candidates cover an interior, a person and a detached statue.
